items.title: How Nvidia's latest deal continues to target all points of the AI trade
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to report on Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the company's bet on open AI models, and now accounting for 8% of the S&P 500 market cap.

items.title: Can PENG Turn Integrated Memory Growth Into an Edge Over Competitors?
items.summary: Penguin Solutions' Integrated Memory surge, CXL offerings and MemoryAI performance gains are sharpening its competitive position in AI infrastructure.

items.title: Will Credo's Neocloud Expansion Broaden Its AEC Growth Runway?
items.summary: CRDO's AEC growth runway is widening as hyperscaler penetration deepens, 1.6T transition advances and Neocloud demand broadens its customer base.

items.title: Why Nvidia Is the Big Winner From Broadcom Earnings
items.summary: Score one to  Nvidia  The chip company emerged as the clear winner over rival  Broadcom  when it comes to the market reaction to their latest earnings report.  It’s not that there was much wrong with Broadcom’s earnings.  Nvidia’s projections were well ahead of what Wall Street analysts had penciled in.

items.title: Broadcom Falls 6% as Soft Guidance Overshadows 221% AI Revenue Surge; NVIDIA Inches Higher, AMD Slips
items.summary: Broadcom's AI revenue just posted a triple-digit surge, yet the stock is getting punished while its biggest rival is trading higher on the same report. The reason comes down to a margin story that is splitting the entire custom-silicon trade in two.

items.title: Marvell Technology Knows Synopsys Is a Huge Threat
items.summary: Marvell and Synopsys both profit from the AI chip boom, but one company is quietly handing hyperscalers the tools to cut the other out entirely. The tension between them reveals something uncomfortable about where custom silicon money actually flows.

items.title: Jim Cramer's Says This Stock Is Primed for a “Huge Move”
items.summary: Jim Cramer says Snowflake stock faces a huge move after a 23% pop, while Broadcom's AI beat gets a cooler read.

items.title: Broadcom’s Outlook Shows Surging AI Chip Sales
items.summary: Broadcom, a key beneficiary of AI data center investment, grew its revenue by 86% in the latest quarter.
